entry.name: Chirurgeon Sabina
entry.title: The Apothecary at the Slab
entry.background: Runs the Slab: graft surgery, excision, flushes and bone-scraping.

entry.name: Berek "Cinder-Lung" Dorn
entry.title: The Tinker at the Hearth
entry.background: Runs the Hearth: training, drills, salvage, repair and reforge.

entry.name: Talia Rusk
entry.title: Basin Spymaster
entry.background: Built the Ash-Crawl bone-cipher network until Inquisitor-General Ruthven's sweep crippled her leg and deafened her right ear with a magnesium flash-charge. Runs the cipher board at the Water-Lock Basin.
entry.personality: Dry, exact, never raises her voice

entry.name: Ivo
entry.title: Talia's Courier
entry.background: A twelve-year-old courier of the Ash-Crawl cipher network, sheltered by Talia. Held in the Seventh Ward Toll-Pen until the Night of the Red Pen.

entry.name: Widow Varka
entry.title: Basin Sluice Fence
entry.background: Salt-widow proprietor of the Leaking Vat sluice line, in a waxed black mourning veil with brass salt-scales. Opens the Basin's black-market Trade once Ivo is home.

entry.name: Bailiff Corvo
entry.title: Third Ward Gatekeeper
entry.background: A bribable Spent Watchman with a Stage II calcified leg who kept his mind on clean water. Keeps the Third Ward gate while he tries to save his sister Ida.

entry.name: Skerrit, Bone-Wright
entry.title: Tenement Bone-Wright
entry.background: A hunchbacked tenement bone-wright and seal-forger who turns Calcified Bone Shards into armour-shredding quarrels and barbed cestuses.

entry.name: Act 1 raid
entry.description: Win the cell's fight at one ward node.

entry.name: Act 1 side-hook
entry.description: Do one errand at a ward node.

entry.name: Act 1 side-hook (Rock Salt)
entry.description: Do one errand at a ward node; paid in Rock Salt.

entry.name: Act 1 side-hook (plating)
entry.description: Do one errand at a ward node; paid in Slag Plating.

cards.text: Two centuries ago the stars and the sun went out. In their place hangs the Shroud. No morning comes. Time is kept only by the cathedral bells.
Beneath the basalt sleeps the Low Sleep, an ancient dreaming leviathan whose nightmares shake the earth and bleed marrow into the wells.

The Clerisy says that if the titan wakes, the world breaks, and that the Red Tithing, sung in young blood each generation, is the lullaby that keeps it asleep. Those who live past five-and-twenty are spent, docile and blind.
In the Seventh Ward, a garrison guard refuses to lock the cages.

Kaelen runs the Lower Meat Market past boiling rendering cauldrons. Hollow-eyed, grey-veined Spent stand in silent queues with wooden bowls, trading curfew tallies for communion draughts and grey salt. Not one of them looks up.
Whistles shriek behind him. Three scourge-bearers in mortuary grey are already on the rooftops, and the smoke over the chimneys is moving the wrong way.
The canal bridge. An iron mortuary cart stands on the span, its shutters chained, and two prisoners rattle inside.

cards.speaker: vesper
cards.text: Chain's black iron. Lever it at the hasp and keep your thumbs out of the way.

cards.speaker: kaelen
cards.text: Watch crossbow on the far rail. Whoever is in there, they've been in there since the bell.

cards.speaker: maren
cards.text: Please. Whatever you are, break it. They have the Scriptorium seals on this cart, and they do not use them for the living.

cards.speaker: hollis
cards.text: Left your sister in a ward, did you? Mine's in a convoy. Get this lid off and give me back my arbalest.
The hasp gives. Footmen on both banks. The cart's captives climb out swinging.

entry.name: Hub Debate: What Keeps Us Alive

cards.text: The Sluice Undercroft. Four fugitives wash up wet to the bone, and a brazier smells of tallow and brass. Four bunks filled of six. Forty-two days on the slate.

cards.speaker: berek_dorn
cards.text: Shake the canal off by the coals, youngsters. The Fourth Kiln valves are pumping something beneath this city, and I cast the throats. Put your faith in honest tempered steel. Iron doesn't dream.

cards.speaker: sabina_kress
cards.text: Steel is a blunt answer, Berek. I have opened what the Tithing leaves behind. Cold steel alone will not kill a Prelate who drinks what the sleeper bleeds. Bring me what the dead leave and I will teach the living to use it.

cards.speaker: berek_dorn
cards.text: And turn them into the things we're running from. You'd pin a stranger's bone into a child and call it medicine.

cards.speaker: talia_rusk
cards.text: Enough. Both of you are arguing over a hearth with forty-two days on the slate. Eat first. Then I'll show these four what the board looks like.

cards.speaker: kaelen
cards.text: I knocked a captain's iron aside tonight and the whole Ward heard it. I'd like to know what we are keeping alive before I ask who's right.

cards.speaker: vesper
cards.text: Alive, mostly. Berek's iron, Sabina's knives, Talia's rods. Pick the one that doesn't bleed you for it.

cards.speaker: maren
cards.text: I copied the chronicle for the Clerisy for six years. If a hearth like this is all that stands between us and the Red Tithing, I want to know what it burns.

cards.speaker: hollis
cards.text: I want to know who is stealing the grates, so I can shoot him.

cards.speaker: talia_rusk
cards.text: The board opens with two jobs, and I want both before anything else moves. Alleyway Junction Seven, where Captain Vane has sealed the grates. The Ash-Crawl Crossroads, where Proctor Quell is emptying cages. Either one first. Both done.
Four valves shut: the Watch grates, the titration cages, the bone-mill chutes and the rendering vats. The raw condensate that fed them has nowhere left to go but down.

cards.speaker: berek_dorn
cards.text: That's pressure. That's not a pipe knocking, that's a conduit with nowhere to vent. Get the bunks clear!

cards.speaker: talia_rusk
cards.text: Eyes on the floor. It's lifting. Everyone who can hold a weapon, with me.
The floor of the Sluice Undercroft splits. Something calcified and enormous drags itself up through the stone, and the drains behind it begin to crawl.

entry.name: Hub Debate: The Price of Our Raids

cards.text: The Undercroft floor lies open. Bone-sediment crust glitters in the brazier light. The smell is brass and marrow.

cards.speaker: berek_dorn
cards.text: Look at that stone. Every valve we shut, the pressure went somewhere. We did this with honest iron and a good plan.

cards.speaker: sabina_kress
cards.text: No, we did it by starving the dream. Every cage we empty, every vat we flood, the city's marrow arteries back up and the Clerisy gets desperate. Cold steel gave this to us and I would like it written on the wall.

cards.speaker: talia_rusk
cards.text: Then write what else it gave us. The Calcified Amalgam dead on the floor. A dreamer's vertebra for the Slab. A map of what lies under the Ward. We pay the price either way. I'd rather know what it buys.

cards.speaker: berek_dorn
cards.text: It buys a worse Tithing, Talia, if the Clerisy decides to answer us. You've read the sweep tallies.

cards.speaker: sabina_kress
cards.text: If we are the cause of a worse rite, then we will be the ones to answer for it. Not the Founders who bled for it. Not the children.

cards.speaker: talia_rusk
cards.text: The Crucible is next. Nemeth holds the Slag Gate, and the only door out of the Ward is behind him. Eat, rest, bind what the Fissure left. We move when the bells change.
The Crucible Watchpost. The winch chain screams. The Slag Gate rises a hand's width, then a forearm, then enough for a body to roll under.
{member:sunk_ward.crucible_stayed} held the winch. Inquisitor-Prelate Nemeth did not strike them down. He took the stayer alive, the way a man takes a coin he intends to spend.
Beyond the Slag Gate the ward ends. The ash falls, and the cathedral bells ring a new hour over Upper Cinderreach.
The Sluice Undercroft, a day and a night later. The brazier burns low. One bunk is made, and nobody has slept in it.

cards.speaker: berek_dorn
cards.text: I told you iron doesn't dream. It doesn't weep either. I'd trade every valve I ever cast to have that bunk slept in tonight.

cards.speaker: sabina_kress
cards.text: Cold steel bounced off Nemeth, Berek. I watched. He does not die of anything you or I can swing. If we want to reach what he took, we have to learn what he drinks.

cards.speaker: berek_dorn
cards.text: That's how they got the prelates. That's how they got whoever he took.

cards.speaker: talia_rusk
cards.text: It is a question for another day. Tonight there are five of us and a gate, and by the next bell there will be a stranger at the Basin door. Eighteen, twenty-four, cowled to the eyes, asking to be taught.

cards.speaker: kaelen
cards.text: We left them there. We opened the Gate and one of us stayed on the winch. I will not forget how that sounded.

cards.speaker: vesper
cards.text: Nobody forgets. We carry it. We send a keepsake home to their bunk and we keep the door open.

cards.speaker: maren
cards.text: The chronicle says the Clerisy took thousands. I have never counted what it costs to take one. Tonight I'm counting.

cards.speaker: talia_rusk
cards.text: Then we count together. Berek will frame the bunks, Sabina will lay out her knives, and I'll bring in the first runaway. The Bastion is next.

entry.name: The Seventh Ward, the Meat Market, the Canal, the Hearth

nodes.text: Chirurgeon Sabina does not look up from the silver scalpel she is wiping on a strip of grey linen. "Mind the floor. It is wet, and not always with water."

choices.text: What do you do down here?
What did you ask me not to touch?
What do you make of the Prelate's valve?

nodes.text: "I cut what Cinderreach cuts into the young, and sometimes I put it back. The Slab does not open all at once. Bring me what the dead leave, and a cell that can stand to know what it is carrying, and I will see."

"The communion draught. Bone-sediment, ground fine, stirred into watered wine. I was an outer-ward prosector at twenty-one. I found the sediment in the commoners' draughts and said so, and Chief Anatomist Lazar sent Proctor Quell to teach me manners. The Spent are not old. They are fed."
"Quell's own retorts. I know that glass. A man who kept Maren's mentor alive on a table long enough to learn what he could take. The Slab can use them. I would rather it did not have to."

"Brass, hot to the touch, hungry. The Inquisition skims aberrant marrow, rots on it, and calls the rot purity. The Clerisy drinks the pure part. Keep that where I can look at it, and not near the Founders until I say."
Berek Dorn turns the loupe on his right eye toward you and lets a rivet drop into a tin. "Coals are hot. Don't breathe in. My lungs can take what yours can't."

choices.text: What did you cast for the Kiln?
Grendel's Slag-Hammer. Can you read it?

nodes.text: "Honest steel. Billhooks, heaters, the odd bodkin. Nothing fancy, nothing that dreams. When there's coin and a spare hour I'll put an edge back on whatever you bring. Not yet, though. I do the hard work in daylight, and there isn't any."

"Fifteen years, valves. Brass throats for what I swore were steam vents. Then Foundry-Master Jessop handed my apprentice Lucan to the Tithing to cover a cracked batch, and I traced the plans. They were made to pump a child's marrow up into the Cloisters. I won't say more until I've found where the pipe goes."
"Pneumatic piston-maul. Grendel's weight in black iron, and a lighter touch than it has any right to. I know the casting. I know the man. I would love to wear it, and I would love not to."
Talia Rusk does not turn her head to look at you. She turns the left ear, the one that still hears. "The board is on the wall. Chalk is ink down here. Read it twice."
"Bone rods, notches by the quarter-hour. Each rod is a runner. Each notch is a drop. If the Watch burns a rod, they've burned the runner, so keep the rods clean."

"Twelve. The fastest courier I ever taught after Vesper. The Watch has him in the Seventh Ward Toll-Pen with a number chalked on his shirt. If the Tithing hits zero first, they take him and not a slate lies. Find the pen. Don't make me ask you twice."
She is quiet for a moment, and her fingers stop on the rod. "Then Varka can open her shelves. The Leaking Vat is yours now, and the Basin will trade without a question. Thank you. I mean that."

"Ruthven's sweep, a magnesium flash-charge, and a crutch of ash-wood. The leg is a bad joke and the ear is worse. I can hear a bone-cipher click at forty paces and nothing on my right. Don't stand there."

entry.name: Widow Varka at the Leaking Vat
entry.speaker: widow_varka

nodes.text: Behind a veil of waxed black crepe, Widow Varka lays a pair of brass salt-scales on the sluice rail. "Everything has a price, dear. Mine are fair, and so is my memory."

choices.text: Why open the Basin to us?

nodes.text: "Rock Salt. Warded Tallow, by the day. Poultices. Whatever the Clerisy has sworn is not for sale, and is. I do not ask what you intend to burn."
"The boy ran my messages before Talia hid him. A woman remembers who feeds a child. The Basin trades with whoever brought him home. That is all the sentiment I can afford."
Ivo sits cross-legged on the Basin steps, still wearing the Toll-Pen number on his shirt. He is twelve, and he is not smiling. "Talia says you took the lock off the pen."

choices.text: What did you see in the pen?

nodes.text: "Ash-Crawl runners aren't safe. We're quick." He almost smiles. "I'll run for you if you want. Whistle twice."
"They count you in tallies of four. When the count's short, they pick the smallest. I counted the sentries instead. There's a gap at the third bell, when they change the chalk."
A hunchbacked figure mutters over a bench of calcified shards, forging a seal onto a strip of bone. "Mind the dust. It bites."
"Quarrels that open mail. Cestuses with barbs for the knuckles. Bone is dull, bone is honest, bone doesn't dream. Bring shards and a cause."
"Black-iron wedges from the Fourth Kiln. Heavy enough to split a mould and fine enough to cut a cestus. Tell the big fellow I owe him. Tell Berek I owe him more."

entry.name: Bailiff Corvo at the Third Ward gate
entry.speaker: bailiff_corvo

nodes.text: Bailiff Corvo leans on the gate-post with a stiff leg that has already turned to grey stone to the knee. "Third Ward gate. You want through, you leave something at the post. Salt or Scrap. I don't care who for."

choices.text: No more tolls. Force the Third Ward gate.
What do you keep behind the gate?

nodes.text: He takes the salt, tucks it into a ledger he doesn't write in, and nods. "Patrols cut short on the Third Ward side tonight. My sister Ida is sixteen and the Tithing is looking for sixteens. If it ever goes badly, don't make it worse."

He pockets the Scrap, tucks it into a ledger he doesn't write in, and nods. "Patrols cut short on the Third Ward side tonight. My sister Ida is sixteen and the Tithing is looking for sixteens. If it ever goes badly, don't make it worse."
"My sister. Ida. Sixteen. I keep the gate so I can keep her indoors. I kept my mind on clean water. It buys me a stone leg and a few more months."

nodes.speaker: maren
nodes.text: Maren kneels by the broken cages and presses grey linen to the cage seals, copying the Clerisy's cipher letter by letter. The cages are open. How many came out walking?

nodes.speaker: maren
nodes.text: Two cell-mates, brown-faced and coughing, grin crookedly as they slip Maren a pinch of Rock Salt each. "For the cipher," says one. "For the next cage." The cage-seal rubbings are legible, and they are not the Clerisy's words.

nodes.speaker: maren
nodes.text: One cell-mate stays, rubbing their wrists. They press a grain of Rock Salt into Maren's palm and say nothing at all. She copies the seal anyway.

nodes.speaker: maren
nodes.text: Maren folds the linen away without a word. "I'll copy what's left. The names will still be on the seals."

nodes.speaker: dunstan
nodes.text: Dunstan stands in the mill-yard with his jaw wired shut and a broken slag-ladle in one fist. Nobody has asked him to speak. He holds the ladle out, handle first.

choices.text: You're one of us now. Take the next bunk.

nodes.speaker: dunstan
nodes.text: Dunstan clamps his wired jaw and nods once, a slow mortar-stone nod. Then he points at the chute where his father's bones came down, and at the mill, and at the road. He means to see all three of them smashed.

nodes.speaker: elyse
nodes.text: Elyse wipes copper-green still-sludge from her goggles and grins crookedly through the smoke. "My mother's tenement is awake, Orlov's guild is a fortnight short of tallow, and I think I need to sit down."

choices.text: Come to the Undercroft. Take the next bunk.

nodes.speaker: elyse
nodes.text: "I make alum tonic. I make tallow. I make the Spent open their eyes. If that sounds like a use, I'd like to be of it." She shoulders a bandolier of phosphorus bottles and falls in beside Vesper.

nodes.speaker: sabina_kress
nodes.text: Chirurgeon Sabina has a vial of black-green marrow in one hand and a scalpel in the other. The floor is already humming. "One of you may take this. Stage One. A pin's head start on what is coming. You will not thank me. Choose."

nodes.speaker: sabina_kress
nodes.text: She turns the vial in the brazier light, waiting.

nodes.speaker: sabina_kress
nodes.text: The vial goes down a throat. Sabina does not watch.

nodes.speaker: sabina_kress
nodes.text: "Then you fight without." The vial goes back under the linen.

entry.name: Talia's Cipher Board
entry.intro: Bone-cipher rods, chalk tallies and a crutch against the wall: Talia posts what the cell can bite off next.

entry.name: The Sweep
entry.description: Captain Vane has sealed the Seventh Ward grates and the Watch is selling captives for a Bastion commission. Break the sweep at Alleyway Junction 7.

steps.text: Break Vane's sweep at Alleyway Junction 7

entry.reward: Talia's thanks, a poultice, and Vane's gate cipher.

entry.name: The Crossroads Cages
entry.description: Proctor Quell runs an open-air titration pen at the Ash-Crawl Crossroads, and the Flagellants cull the cages by the bell. Free them.

steps.text: Free the cages at the Ash-Crawl Crossroads

entry.reward: Talia's thanks, a poultice, and Quell's retorts for the Slab.

entry.name: The Bone-Mill Raid
entry.description: Overseer Grendel grinds uncremated Spent into bone-mortar at the Fourth Kiln. Wreck the mill and free the chain gang.

steps.text: Wreck the Bone-Mill at the Fourth Kiln

entry.reward: Talia's thanks, a poultice, and a new bunk.
entry.closed_text: Clear the Sweep and the Cages first.

entry.name: The Tallow Vats
entry.description: Guild-Master Orlov brings Render-Beasts and Dredgers to burn out a young chemist at the Tallow Vats. Cut through and find her.

steps.text: Cut through the Tallow Vats and find the chemist

entry.reward: Talia's thanks, a poultice, and Orlov's Retribution; five days of Warded Tallow wait in Orlov's stores.
entry.closed_text: Clear the Sweep and the Cages first.

entry.name: The Drowned Sluice
entry.description: Inquisitor-Prelate Nemeth holds the Crucible Watchpost and the Slag Gate behind it. Open the gate. One of you holds the winch.

steps.text: Hold the Crucible and open the Slag Gate

entry.reward: Talia's thanks. The Bastion waits beyond the gate.

set.description: Hollis dropped the Crucible's outer counterweight and the gate's reinforcements will arrive a round late. Open the Slag Gate. One of you holds the winch.

entry.closed_text: Something under the Undercroft must be answered first.

entry.name: Corvo's Gate
entry.description: Bailiff Corvo keeps the Third Ward gate. Settle the toll with Scrap or Rock Salt, or break it open and risk his sister Ida.

steps.text: Settle the toll at the Third Ward gate

entry.reward: Talia's thanks, and either a quiet gate or a loud one.

entry.name: The Night of the Red Pen
entry.description: Talia's courier Ivo, twelve, is chalked into the Seventh Ward Toll-Pen at the Ash-Crawl Crossroads. Take him out before the Tithing clock runs down.

steps.text: Bring Ivo out of the Toll-Pen

entry.reward: Talia's thanks, and Widow Varka's shelves.

entry.name: The Seventh Ward Bellows
entry.description: Kaelen's old Watch armory cache lies beneath Alleyway Junction 7, with a bellows nobody was told to burn. Take it, and a plate Berek can rework.

steps.text: Raid the old Watch armory cache at Alleyway Junction 7

entry.reward: Slag Plating, and cheaper coals at Berek's Hearth.

entry.name: The Sluice Lock-Ciphers
entry.description: Vesper knows the flood-lock tablets under the Drowned Runoff Grate. Map them and the drains give the cell a quiet road of its own.

steps.text: Map the forgotten flood-locks at the Drowned Runoff Grate

entry.reward: A permanent Siphon Shortcut with no Alert on the road.

entry.name: Liturgical Cipher Rubbings
entry.description: Maren will decode the cage-seal rubbings from the Crossroads. Take them to St. Lyra's hidden reliquary flue.

steps.text: Take the cage-seal rubbings at the Ash-Crawl Crossroads

entry.reward: Maren's clue to St. Lyra's flue, for Act 2.

entry.name: The Crag-Sight Overlook
entry.description: Hollis wants the chimney sightlines above the Crucible and the outer counterweight cut. The Prelate's reinforcements arrive a round late.

steps.text: Secure the Crag-Sight Overlook above the Crucible

entry.reward: Hollis's Lever-Winch, and a gate wave that arrives a round late.
entry.closed_text: Something under the Undercroft must be answered first.

entry.name: Chain-Gang Wedges
entry.description: Dunstan will pull the black-iron wedges from the ruined mill. Skerrit, Bone-Wright wants them.

steps.text: Pull the black-iron wedges from the Fourth Kiln

entry.reward: Rock Salt, and Skerrit's bone-shard recipes.
entry.closed_text: Free the Bone-Mill's chain gang first.

entry.name: The Tenement Counter-Still
entry.description: Elyse will check her awakened mother's tenement block and distil tallow. The Vats' leftover stills are hot.

steps.text: Check the counter-still at the Tallow Vats

entry.closed_text: Cut through the Tallow Vats first.

entry.name: The Sluice Undercroft
entry.description: Node 00, the hub: a flooded undercroft with six bunks, a brazier, the Tinker's Hearth, the Apothecary's Slab and the Water-Lock Basin, below the Sunk Ward.

entry.name: Drowned Runoff Grate
entry.description: Node 01: the egress and checkpoint where the drains meet the streets. Flood-lock tablets stand under the silt.

markers.label: A forgotten flood-lock tablet
markers.note: Vesper wipes the silt off a bronze lock-plate and reads the old sluice routes aloud. The drains answer.

entry.name: Alleyway Junction 7
entry.description: Node 02: a street crossing in the Seventh Ward where Captain Vane has sealed the grates.

markers.label: The old Watch armory cache
markers.note: Behind a loose course of bricks: Kaelen's old Watch cache, a soot-black bellows and a heavy plate for Berek to rework.

entry.name: Ash-Crawl Crossroads
entry.description: Node 03: an open-air culling station where the slum alleys meet, with the Seventh Ward Toll-Pen beside the cages.

markers.label: The Seventh Ward Toll-Pen
markers.note: A boy with a chalked number on his shirt counts sentries on his fingers. The lock gives. He keeps counting until the grate is behind you.

markers.label: The cage-seal rubbings
markers.note: Maren spreads grey linen over the open cage seals and rubs. The Clerisy's cipher rises in white lines. St. Lyra's name is in it.

entry.name: The Fourth Kiln
entry.description: Node 04: the bone-mill that mortars the Inquisition's watch-posts out of uncremated Spent.

markers.label: A pile of black-iron wedges
markers.note: Dunstan lifts the splitting wedges from the ruined mill one at a time, like a man picking his own name out of a ledger.

entry.name: The Tallow Vats
entry.description: Node 05: the Guild's rendering vats and still-rooms, where Tallow Dredgers boil the district's dead.

markers.label: Elyse's counter-still
markers.note: A coil of copper pipe and a leaking alum drum in the corner of a tenement block. Elyse tips a measure of clean tallow into a flask and corks it with her thumb.

entry.name: Crucible Watchpost
entry.description: Node 06: the fortified post above the Slag Gate, with the winch that lifts it.

markers.label: The Crag-Sight Overlook
markers.note: Hollis climbs the chimney stack and drops the outer counterweight from the gutter. The gate's reinforcements will have to take the long way round.

entry.name: The Slag Gate
entry.description: Node 07: the gate out of the Sunk Ward, beneath the Crucible Watchpost. Beyond it lies Upper Cinderreach.

entry.name: Corvo's Gate
entry.description: Node 1d: the Third Ward gate, where Bailiff Corvo keeps a bribable post.

markers.label: World map: the Third Ward road

entry.name: The Alleyway of Cinders
entry.description: Prologue 0a: a narrow Seventh Ward alley, night, rain and a sputtering warded tallow lantern.

entry.name: Meat Market Rooftops
entry.description: Prologue 0b: the slate roofs above the Lower Meat Market.

entry.name: The Canal Bridge
entry.description: Prologue 0c: an iron bridge over the canal where a mortuary cart stands chained.

entry.name: The Alley
entry.description: Prologue: a curfew sweep in the Alleyway of Cinders.
entry.intro: The curfew bell tolls and two Castellan Footmen close the alley.

effects.text: The alley shudders as the distant curfew bell tolls. Watch whistles shrill down the lane.

entry.objective_text: Strike while they wind up: a quick Pommel Strike breaks a slow blow.

entry.name: The Rooftop
entry.description: Prologue: the Meat Market rooftops; Vesper joins.
entry.intro: Three Mortuary Flagellants rush across the slates.
entry.objective_text: Follow the smoke: hide, guard each other, slip away.

entry.name: The Bridge
entry.description: Prologue: the canal bridge; Maren and Hollis are freed from the iron cart.
entry.intro: Footmen hold the canal bridge against the cart's captives.
entry.objective_text: Free the cart's captives and hold the bridge.

entry.name: Corvo's Gate
entry.description: The loud answer to Bailiff Corvo's toll.
entry.intro: The Third Ward gate is held by a Bailiff's picked men.

entry.name: The Sweep
entry.description: M1, Tier 1: Captain Vane's grate sweep at Junction 7.
entry.intro: Vane's sweep is closing the grates, wall by wall.

effects.text: Lock shields! Seventh Ward, with me!

entry.objective_text: Break Vane's sweep before the grates are sealed.

entry.name: The Tallow Vats
entry.description: M4, Tier 2: Guild-Master Orlov's rendering vats; Elyse joins.
entry.intro: Boiling fat and greased catwalks: Orlov's floor.

effects.text: Into the vats, the lot of you!
Back to the upper vats—seal the sluices!

entry.objective_text: Cut through the vats; find the chemist.

fields.tagline: Act 1, The Young Vanguard: the lowest quarter of Cinderreach.
